returned_title: European Values Study (EVS) 2017–2021: Integrated Dataset
justification: One of the most relevant datasets for the requested research. Contains nationally representative survey data from 36 European countries, including Albania, Armenia, Austria, Azerbaijan, Belarus, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Bulgaria, Croatia, Czech Republic, Denmark, Estonia, Finland, France, Georgia, Germany, Great Britain, Hungary, Iceland, Italy, Lithuania, Montenegro, Netherlands, North Macedonia, Norway, Poland, Romania, Russia, Serbia, Slovakia, Slovenia, Sweden, Spain, Switzerland, Portugal, Ukraine, and Latvia. Covers employment attitudes, cultural and national identity, religion, family and marriage, political participation, gender roles, environmental values, and social trust. Data were collected between 2017 and 2021. Particularly suitable for cross-national comparisons.

returned_title: Joint European Values Study and World Values Survey (EVS/WVS) 2017–2022 Dataset
justification: Highly relevant harmonized cross-national dataset combining the European Values Study and World Values Survey. Contains more than 156,000 respondents across 92 countries and territories, including all 37 countries requested. Covers attitudes toward work, national identity, religion, marriage, family relationships, political institutions, democracy, gender equality, and environmental protection. Particularly valuable for comparing Eastern and Western European societies during the late 2010s and early 2020s. The dataset includes common questionnaire items designed to support international comparisons.

returned_title: World Values Survey (WVS) Wave 7, 2017–2022
justification: International survey dataset covering social, cultural, economic, religious, and political values. Relevant participating countries include Armenia, Czech Republic, Germany, Great Britain, Netherlands, Romania, Russia, Serbia, Slovakia, and Ukraine. Includes questions on employment, national pride, religious beliefs, marriage, gender equality, political trust, democratic values, and environmental attitudes. Useful for examining changing social values during the late 2010s and early 2020s. Country availability varies by wave.

returned_title: World Values Survey (WVS) Wave 6, 2010–2014
justification: Provides nationally representative survey data collected during the early 2010s. Includes questions about employment, subjective well-being, national identity, religion, family values, gender equality, political participation, social trust, and environmental protection. Particularly useful for establishing a baseline against which changes observed in the 2017–2022 wave can be compared. Geographic coverage varies by country and survey wave.

returned_title: World Values Survey Time-Series Dataset, 1981–2022
justification: Longitudinal cross-national dataset combining seven waves of the World Values Survey, including the 2010–2014 and 2017–2022 waves. Supports research on changes in religion, cultural identity, political participation, employment values, family life, gender attitudes, and environmental concerns. Allows researchers to investigate social value changes across multiple decades, including the requested 2010s and 2020s. Not every requested country participated in every wave.

returned_title: European Values Study and World Values Survey: Integrated Values Surveys, 1981–2022
justification: Integrated longitudinal resource combining the European Values Study and World Values Survey trend files. Designed to facilitate comparisons of social, cultural, religious, political, and economic values across countries and time. Particularly relevant for examining changes in attitudes toward employment, family relationships, marriage, religion, national identity, gender equality, democracy, and environmental protection during the 2010s and early 2020s. Coverage spans European and non-European societies, with country availability depending on survey participation.

returned_title: European Social Survey (ESS): Cumulative Cross-National Survey Data, Rounds 5–11
justification: Major comparative European survey providing repeated cross-sectional data from the 2010s and 2020s. Relevant countries include Albania, Austria, Bulgaria, Croatia, Czech Republic, Denmark, Estonia, Finland, France, Germany, Great Britain, Hungary, Iceland, Italy, Lithuania, Netherlands, Norway, Poland, Portugal, Serbia, Slovakia, Slovenia, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, and Ukraine, depending on the survey round. Covers employment, immigration, national identity, religion, political participation, institutional trust, gender attitudes, subjective well-being, and environmental concerns. The data builder allows users to select specific countries, survey rounds, and variables.

returned_title: European Social Survey (ESS): Country and Round Data Builder
justification: Official European Social Survey data portal providing access to individual survey rounds and country-specific datasets. Suitable for examining political behavior, voting, trust in government, national identity, religion, employment, social inequalities, family characteristics, and environmental attitudes. Its recurring core questionnaire supports comparisons across the 2010s and 2020s, while rotating modules provide more detailed coverage of selected subjects. Participation varies by country and round.

returned_title: International Social Survey Programme (ISSP): Environment III, 2010, and Environment IV, 2020
justification: Internationally comparative survey datasets specifically focused on environmental attitudes and conservation. Covers environmental concern, willingness to pay for environmental protection, climate-related attitudes, perceived environmental threats, personal environmental behavior, and support for government environmental policies. Includes participating European countries from the requested list, with geographic coverage differing between the 2010 and 2020 modules. Particularly useful for analyzing changes in environmental values across the decade.

returned_title: International Social Survey Programme (ISSP): Environment Cumulation, 1993–2020
justification: Harmonized longitudinal collection combining the ISSP Environment surveys from 1993, 2000, 2010, and 2020. Includes information about environmental protection, conservation attitudes, ecological behavior, perceptions of environmental risks, and support for environmental regulations. Particularly useful for comparing environmental attitudes in participating European countries between 2010 and 2020 and placing those changes in a longer historical context.

returned_title: International Social Survey Programme (ISSP): Family and Changing Gender Roles IV, 2012
justification: Cross-national dataset focusing on family relationships, marriage, gender norms, employment of women, household responsibilities, childcare, and attitudes toward traditional and egalitarian family structures. Includes European participating countries from the requested geographic scope. Particularly relevant for examining family life and gender roles during the early 2010s. Can be compared with the 2022 module to investigate changes across a decade.

returned_title: International Social Survey Programme (ISSP): Family and Changing Gender Roles V, 2022
justification: Highly relevant dataset specifically covering family life, marriage, and gender roles during the 2020s. Participating European countries include Austria, Bulgaria, Czech Republic, Denmark, Finland, France, Germany, Hungary, Iceland, Italy, Lithuania, Netherlands, Norway, Poland, Slovakia, Slovenia, Sweden, and Switzerland. Examines attitudes toward women's employment, childcare, marriage, parenting, household labor, and gender equality. Data collection extended from 2021 to 2024, making this a valuable source for recent cross-national comparisons.

returned_title: International Social Survey Programme (ISSP): Family and Changing Gender Roles Cumulation, 1988–2022
justification: Longitudinal dataset bringing together surveys from 1988, 1994, 2002, 2012, and 2022. Enables analysis of changes in marriage attitudes, women's employment, parenting expectations, household responsibilities, family structures, and gender-role beliefs. Especially useful for examining transformations in family values between the 2010s and 2020s among participating European countries.

returned_title: International Social Survey Programme (ISSP): National Identity III, 2013
justification: Cross-national survey module focusing on national belonging, patriotism, nationalism, immigration attitudes, citizenship, ethnic identity, cultural diversity, and national pride. Includes participating European countries relevant to the requested geographic scope. Particularly suitable for studying cultural and national identity during the 2010s and examining differences between European societies.

returned_title: International Social Survey Programme (ISSP): National Identity Cumulation, 1995–2013
justification: Harmonized longitudinal dataset combining the 1995, 2003, and 2013 National Identity surveys. Covers national attachment, national pride, citizenship, cultural belonging, immigration, and attitudes toward globalization. Provides a historical perspective on national identity and allows analysis of the 2013 observations in relation to earlier periods. Geographic coverage is limited to participating countries.

returned_title: International Social Survey Programme (ISSP): Religion IV, 2018
justification: International survey module focusing on religious beliefs, religious participation, spirituality, secularization, religious identity, moral attitudes, and the role of religion in society. Includes participating European countries and provides detailed individual-level information relevant to religion and values. Particularly useful for comparing religious attitudes across European societies during the late 2010s.

returned_title: International Social Survey Programme (ISSP): Religion Cumulation, 1991–2018
justification: Longitudinal collection combining religion surveys conducted in 1991, 1998, 2008, and 2018. Provides harmonized measures of religious belief, religious practice, secularization, religious identity, and moral values. Useful for identifying long-term changes in European religious attitudes, including those observed during the 2010s.

returned_title: International Social Survey Programme (ISSP): Work Orientations IV, 2015
justification: Cross-national survey module examining labor and employment attitudes. Topics include job satisfaction, job security, employment preferences, workplace relationships, career expectations, work-life balance, and the importance of work in personal identity. Includes participating European countries from the requested list. Particularly useful for understanding subjective experiences of employment during the mid-2010s.

returned_title: International Social Survey Programme (ISSP): Work Orientations Cumulation, 1989–2015
justification: Harmonized longitudinal dataset combining Work Orientations surveys from 1989, 1997, 2005, and 2015. Covers employment values, job satisfaction, occupational preferences, workplace autonomy, job security, and work-life balance. Particularly suitable for investigating how attitudes toward work changed leading into and during the 2010s in participating European countries.

returned_title: International Social Survey Programme (ISSP): Social Inequality V, 2019
justification: International survey module investigating perceptions of economic inequality, social mobility, income differences, occupational status, fairness, and redistribution. Particularly relevant to labor and employment, political attitudes, and social values. Includes European participating countries and provides individual-level measures suitable for comparative research during the late 2010s.

returned_title: International Social Survey Programme (ISSP): Social Inequality Cumulation, 1987–2019
justification: Harmonized collection of five survey waves examining perceived inequality, class differences, economic fairness, social mobility, and attitudes toward income redistribution. Includes the 2019 survey and supports long-term comparisons. Particularly useful for studying relationships between employment, economic insecurity, social identity, and political values in European societies.

returned_title: International Social Survey Programme (ISSP): Citizenship II, 2014
justification: Cross-national dataset investigating political participation, civic engagement, citizenship norms, political trust, democratic responsibilities, and attitudes toward government. Provides relevant data for political behavior and attitudes, national identity, and civic values. Particularly useful for examining political participation and democratic citizenship in European countries during the 2010s.

returned_title: International Social Survey Programme (ISSP): Role of Government V, 2016
justification: International survey dataset investigating attitudes toward government responsibilities, public spending, social welfare, economic regulation, political institutions, and state intervention. Relevant to political behavior, political attitudes, employment policy preferences, and social values. Allows comparisons of government-related attitudes among participating European countries during the 2010s.

returned_title: International Social Survey Programme (ISSP): Role of Government Cumulation, 1985–2016
justification: Harmonized longitudinal dataset combining the 1985, 1990, 1996, 2006, and 2016 Role of Government modules. Contains information on government intervention, welfare provision, political trust, public spending, and attitudes toward state responsibilities. Useful for examining changes in political and economic attitudes leading into the 2010s and comparing participating European countries.

returned_title: International Social Survey Programme (ISSP): Social Networks and Social Resources, 2017
justification: Cross-national survey module investigating social networks, interpersonal support, social resources, and relationships between individuals and communities. Relevant to family life, cultural values, employment opportunities, social trust, and social integration. Particularly valuable for examining how social relationships influence employment experiences and social attitudes in European societies during the late 2010s.

returned_title: European Union Labour Force Survey (EU-LFS): Scientific Use Microdata, 1983–2024
justification: Major harmonized European labor-market dataset providing individual-level information on employment, unemployment, occupation, working hours, educational attainment, labor-force participation, and demographic characteristics. Covers EU member states and participating EFTA and candidate countries. Relevant countries include Austria, Bulgaria, Croatia, Czech Republic, Denmark, Estonia, Finland, France, Germany, Hungary, Iceland, Italy, Latvia, Lithuania, Netherlands, Norway, Poland, Portugal, Romania, Slovakia, Slovenia, Spain, Sweden, and Switzerland. Historical United Kingdom data are also available. Suitable for detailed labor-market and gender employment comparisons throughout the 2010s and 2020s. Scientific-use microdata require authorized access.

returned_title: European Union Labour Force Survey (EU-LFS): Public Microdata
justification: Publicly accessible anonymized microdata derived from the European Union Labour Force Survey. Contains information related to labor-force participation, employment, unemployment, occupational characteristics, and demographic variables. Relevant to studying employment patterns and gender differences in labor-market participation. Public-use files are available for selected European countries and years. These files are intended primarily for training and methodological preparation rather than population-level statistical inference.

returned_title: European Union Labour Force Survey: Employment and Unemployment Statistics
justification: Official European labor-market statistical collection providing employment and unemployment indicators, labor-force participation rates, working-time measures, and demographic breakdowns. Covers EU countries and participating EFTA and candidate countries, including Bosnia and Herzegovina and Serbia. Particularly useful for comparing employment outcomes by gender, age, education, and country across the 2010s and 2020s. Provides an accessible alternative to restricted scientific-use microdata.

returned_title: European Working Conditions Telephone Survey (EWCTS) 2021
justification: European comparative survey focusing on employment conditions during the COVID-19 period. Covers job quality, working hours, workplace risks, occupational health, work-life balance, employment security, and experiences of workers. Particularly relevant to labor and employment, gender differences in working conditions, and family-work relationships. Provides cross-national data for participating European countries during 2021.

returned_title: International Social Survey Programme (ISSP): Complete Dataset Catalogue
justification: Official catalogue of internationally harmonized survey datasets covering nearly all requested thematic areas. Particularly relevant modules include Environment 2010 and 2020, Family and Changing Gender Roles 2012 and 2022, National Identity 2013, Religion 2018, Work Orientations 2015, Citizenship 2014, Role of Government 2016, and Social Inequality 2019. The catalogue is especially useful for identifying datasets with matching thematic questions and checking participating countries, data availability, and documentation.

returned_title: European Social Survey (ESS) – Rounds 10 and 11 (2020–2024)
justification: A major cross-national survey covering political behaviour, national identity, immigration attitudes, trust in government, democratic values, social attitudes, and economic perceptions. Rounds 10 (2020–2022) and 11 (2023–2024) are particularly relevant. Participating countries include Belgium, Bulgaria, Czechia, Denmark, Germany, Estonia, Ireland, Greece, Spain, France, Italy, Lithuania, Hungary, Netherlands, Austria, Poland, Portugal, Slovakia, Slovenia, Finland, Sweden, Croatia, Serbia, the United Kingdom, and others. Country participation varies by round. Provides individual-level survey microdata suitable for comparative research.

returned_title: Standard Eurobarometer Surveys – 2020–2026
justification: Repeated public opinion surveys covering political attitudes, European identity, national identity, trust in institutions, European integration, economic conditions, democracy, security, and international politics. Covers all 27 EU member states, including Belgium, Bulgaria, Czechia, Denmark, Germany, Estonia, Ireland, Greece, Spain, France, Italy, Cyprus, Latvia, Lithuania, Luxembourg, Hungary, Malta, Netherlands, Austria, Poland, Portugal, Romania, Slovenia, Slovakia, Finland, Sweden, and Croatia. Particularly useful for tracking changes in public opinion throughout the 2020s.

returned_title: Special Eurobarometer Surveys – Political Attitudes, European Identity, Security and Democracy
justification: Thematic public opinion datasets addressing European citizenship, identity, democratic participation, political institutions, international relations, security, defence, economic expectations, and EU policies. Surveys conducted throughout the 2020s provide comparable information across EU member states. Particularly useful for investigating attitudes toward the European Union, foreign policy, international security, and institutional trust.

returned_title: Joint European Values Study and World Values Survey (EVS/WVS) 2017–2022
justification: Harmonized cross-national survey dataset covering cultural identity, national pride, religion, political participation, democratic values, political trust, attitudes toward government, social tolerance, and economic beliefs. Includes observations from the early 2020s alongside earlier fieldwork. Covers many requested countries, including Albania, Austria, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Bulgaria, Croatia, Cyprus, Czechia, Denmark, Estonia, Finland, France, Georgia, Germany, Greece, Hungary, Italy, Latvia, Lithuania, Montenegro, Netherlands, North Macedonia, Poland, Portugal, Romania, Serbia, Slovakia, Slovenia, Spain, Sweden, Turkey, and the United Kingdom. Particularly valuable for comparative studies of cultural and national identity.

returned_title: Integrated Values Surveys (IVS) 1981–2022
justification: Combines European Values Study and World Values Survey data into a harmonized longitudinal resource. Includes measurements of cultural identity, nationalism, political engagement, democracy, institutional confidence, social values, religion, and economic attitudes. Provides historical context and observations extending into the 2020s for many European countries, including EU members and countries in the Western Balkans and Eastern Europe.

returned_title: Varieties of Democracy (V-Dem) Dataset Version 16 (2026)
justification: Comprehensive country-year dataset measuring electoral democracy, liberal democracy, political participation, freedom of expression, civil society, government accountability, political equality, and institutional performance. The 2026 release includes observations through 2025. Covers the requested European countries and provides comparable indicators for analysing government systems, democratic development, institutional change, and political freedoms during the 2020s.

returned_title: World Bank Worldwide Governance Indicators (WGI) – 2026 Update
justification: Annual country-level governance indicators covering voice and accountability, political stability, government effectiveness, regulatory quality, rule of law, and control of corruption. The 2026 update provides data through 2025. Covers more than 200 economies, including the requested EU countries, Western Balkan states, Moldova, Georgia, Turkey, and the United Kingdom. Particularly useful for comparing government quality, political stability, and institutional performance.

returned_title: International IDEA – Global State of Democracy Indices
justification: Annual country-level democracy indicators covering representation, rights, rule of law, and political participation. Provides comparable measurements for European democracies and countries experiencing political transitions. Includes observations from the 2020s and supports analysis of democratic institutions, elections, political rights, government accountability, and democratic resilience.

returned_title: International IDEA – Voter Turnout Database
justification: International dataset containing parliamentary, presidential, and European Parliament election turnout statistics. Includes voter registration, voting-age population, turnout rates, and invalid votes. Covers European countries and elections occurring throughout the 2020s. Particularly useful for studying political behaviour, electoral participation, democratic engagement, and cross-national differences in voting patterns.

returned_title: Chapel Hill Expert Survey (CHES) – 2024 European Political Party Positions
justification: Expert-coded dataset measuring political party positions on European integration, ideology, immigration, economic redistribution, populism, democracy, and EU policy. The 2024 survey covers 279 political parties in 31 countries, including EU member states except Luxembourg, alongside Turkey and the United Kingdom. Particularly relevant for political behaviour, national identity, government systems, party competition, and international political integration.

returned_title: SPEED-CHES Surveys – COVID-19 (2020) and Ukraine (2023)
justification: Specialized expert surveys measuring European political party positions on major international events. The 2020 survey examines party positions on pandemic-related policies, while the 2023 survey addresses political responses to Russia's war against Ukraine. Covers numerous European countries and provides evidence on political polarization, international security, European integration, government responses, and foreign policy attitudes.

returned_title: Manifesto Project Dataset – 2026 Release
justification: Comparative dataset coding political party election manifestos across countries and elections. Includes information on nationalism, national identity, international relations, European integration, government policy, economic priorities, defence, security, democracy, and social issues. The dataset contains election programmes from the 2020s and is particularly useful for examining party ideology, political competition, and government policy preferences.

returned_title: Eurostat Database – Economic, Social and Government Statistics
justification: Official European statistical database providing harmonized indicators on GDP, inflation, unemployment, poverty, inequality, government expenditure, public debt, population, migration, and economic conditions. Contains annual, quarterly, and monthly observations throughout the 2020s. Covers all requested EU countries and provides selected indicators for enlargement countries and other European economies. Particularly useful for analysing economic conditions alongside political and social developments.

returned_title: World Bank – World Development Indicators (WDI)
justification: Comprehensive cross-national economic and development dataset containing indicators on GDP, economic growth, inflation, unemployment, government finances, trade, poverty, inequality, and demographic conditions. Covers approximately 220 economies, including EU member states, Turkey, the United Kingdom, Western Balkan countries, Moldova, Georgia, and Kosovo. Provides time-series data throughout the 2020s, enabling comparisons between economic conditions and political developments.

returned_title: Uppsala Conflict Data Program (UCDP) – Armed Conflict Dataset
justification: International conflict dataset documenting state-based armed conflicts, conflict actors, conflict intensity, and battle-related deaths. Version 26.1 covers armed conflicts through 2025. Provides evidence for examining international security, peace, interstate relations, and organized violence. Relevant to conflict and security analysis involving European countries, including Turkey, Georgia, Moldova, and the Western Balkans. Not every country necessarily records qualifying armed conflict events.

returned_title: UCDP Georeferenced Event Dataset (GED) – Version 26.1
justification: Geographically disaggregated dataset documenting organized violence, including event locations, dates, actors, fatalities, and types of violence. The 2026 release includes events through 2025. Useful for investigating conflict dynamics, security threats, political violence, and regional instability. Allows researchers to filter relevant observations for European countries and neighbouring regions. Coverage is limited to events meeting UCDP inclusion criteria.

returned_title: UCDP Non-State Conflict and One-Sided Violence Datasets
justification: Datasets documenting organized violence between non-state actors and deliberate violence against civilians. Provide country-year and conflict-level information extending into the 2020s. Relevant for analysing security, political violence, civilian protection, and peace in European and neighbouring countries. Particularly useful when combined with UCDP state-based armed conflict data to distinguish different forms of organized violence.

returned_title: World Bank – Worldwide Governance Indicators: Political Stability and Absence of Violence
justification: The political stability component of the Worldwide Governance Indicators measures perceptions of the likelihood of political instability and politically motivated violence. Includes annual observations through 2025 in the 2026 update. Covers the requested countries and is particularly useful for comparing political security conditions even where no armed conflict is recorded. Can be combined with measures of government effectiveness, rule of law, and democratic accountability.

returned_title: OSCE Office for Democratic Institutions and Human Rights – Election Observation Data and Reports
justification: Collection of election observation findings and electoral assessments covering parliamentary, presidential, and local elections across OSCE participating states. Includes elections during the 2020s in countries such as Albania, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Georgia, Moldova, Montenegro, North Macedonia, Serbia, Turkey, and numerous EU member states. Particularly useful for analysing electoral integrity, democratic institutions, political participation, and government accountability. Primarily a collection of structured election records and reports rather than a harmonized survey microdata file.

returned_title: International IDEA – Democracy Tracker
justification: Event-oriented democracy monitoring resource documenting important developments in democratic governance, political institutions, civil liberties, electoral processes, and rule of law. Its coverage begins in August 2022 and includes a broad international country sample. Useful for examining political developments and democratic changes during the 2020s, particularly alongside annual democracy indices.

returned_title: GESIS Eurobarometer Data Service – European Parliament and Political Participation Surveys
justification: Provides access to Eurobarometer survey microdata, including studies addressing European Parliament elections, European identity, EU citizenship, institutional trust, democratic participation, and political priorities. Relevant surveys from the 2020s cover EU member states and enable comparisons of political behaviour and attitudes toward European political organisations. Particularly valuable for analysing the relationship between national identity and support for European integration.

returned_title: GESIS European Values Study – Data and Documentation
justification: Official archive for European Values Study datasets covering national identity, religion, democracy, political trust, government attitudes, economic beliefs, and social values. Provides access to integrated and longitudinal datasets, including the Joint EVS/WVS 2017–2022 release. Useful for comparing cultural and political attitudes across EU countries, the Western Balkans, Turkey, Georgia, and other European countries. Researchers should check individual national fieldwork years when restricting analysis to 2020 onward.

returned_title: Chapel Hill Expert Survey – European Political Party Trend File
justification: Longitudinal political party dataset combining expert assessments across European survey waves, including 2019 and 2024. Measures party positions on nationalism-related issues, immigration, European integration, economic redistribution, social policy, and political ideology. Enables analysis of changes in political party positions entering and during the 2020s across a substantial number of European countries.

returned_title: International IDEA – Global Democracy Data and Electoral Indicators
justification: International IDEA's data portal provides access to datasets concerning democracy, elections, electoral participation, institutional arrangements, and democratic governance. Supports comparative political analysis across European states, including several Western Balkan and Eastern European countries. Particularly useful for combining institutional indicators with electoral behaviour and political participation data from the 2020s.

returned_title: German Longitudinal Election Study (GLES) – Federal Elections 2021 and 2025
justification: One of Germany's most comprehensive election research programs. Provides individual-level survey datasets covering the 2021 and 2025 federal elections, including voting behavior, party preferences, political attitudes, electoral participation, political trust, and campaign effects. Includes cross-sectional surveys, longitudinal panels, candidate studies, and campaign-related data. Particularly valuable for analyzing changes in German political behavior throughout the 2020s.

returned_title: German Federal Election 2025 – Official Election Results Open Data
justification: Official machine-readable election results published by Germany's Federal Returning Officer. Includes party vote shares, constituency-level results, first and second votes, voter turnout, and geographical identifiers. Provides CSV and XML formats and archived results from the 2021 election. Suitable for analyzing electoral geography, party competition, regional voting differences, and changes in political representation.

returned_title: German Federal Election 2025 – Official Results and Historical Election Statistics
justification: Official electoral statistics covering Germany's 2025 Bundestag election, with historical federal election results for comparison. Includes constituency and federal-state results, elected representatives, turnout statistics, and party performance. Useful for longitudinal studies of electoral participation, political representation, and changes in Germany's party system during the 2020s.

returned_title: Politbarometer 2025 – Cumulated Data Set
justification: A nationally focused political opinion survey dataset archived by GESIS and produced by Forschungsgruppe Wahlen. Contains responses from approximately 32,500 observations covering voting intentions, party identification, government satisfaction, coalition preferences, perceptions of politicians, political trust, and attitudes toward public policy. Particularly suitable for studying public opinion and electoral behavior in Germany during 2025.

returned_title: Politbarometer – German Political Opinion Surveys, 2020s
justification: Long-running German political opinion survey series with annual cumulative datasets covering the 2020s. Measures political attitudes, party preferences, voting intentions, satisfaction with democracy, government approval, political leadership evaluations, and public perceptions of national issues. Enables comparisons of political opinion during different governments and electoral cycles.

returned_title: German General Social Survey (ALLBUS) – 2020s Surveys
justification: Major representative social survey program examining attitudes, values, and behavior among Germany's population. Includes survey data from the 2020s and a cumulative dataset extending through 2023. Relevant variables include political interest, political participation, social trust, attitudes toward democracy, political orientations, social inequality, immigration, and institutional confidence. Useful for examining the social foundations of German political behavior.

returned_title: ALLBUS – German General Social Survey, Cumulative Data 1980–2023
justification: Provides access to harmonized survey data spanning several decades, including observations from the 2020s. Particularly useful for investigating changes in political attitudes, ideological orientations, democratic values, social divisions, and political participation. Supports comparisons between contemporary German political behavior and earlier historical periods.

returned_title: GESIS Election Studies – German Federal and State Elections
justification: Research data collection covering federal elections, state elections, political attitudes, and voter behavior in Germany. Provides access to the German Longitudinal Election Study, Politbarometer surveys, representative electoral surveys, and other political opinion datasets. Particularly useful for identifying comparable datasets covering elections and political behavior throughout the 2020s.

returned_title: Politbarometer – German Political Opinion Survey Data Collection
justification: GESIS research data catalog containing individual Politbarometer datasets and annual cumulative survey files. Includes data collected during the 2020s on party preferences, political leaders, coalition preferences, government performance, electoral intentions, political issues, and democratic attitudes. Useful for locating individual survey waves and constructing longitudinal analyses of public opinion.

returned_title: German Bundestag – Parliamentary Open Data
justification: Official open data published by Germany's federal parliament. Provides machine-readable parliamentary proceedings, legislative documents, roll-call voting records, and biographical information about members of parliament. Includes material from the 20th Bundestag (2021–2025) and 21st Bundestag (beginning in 2025). Relevant for studying legislative behavior, government-opposition relations, parliamentary organizations, coalition politics, and political representation.

returned_title: ParlGov – Parliaments and Governments Database
justification: Comparative political science database containing information about political parties, national elections, government cabinets, and coalition composition across established democracies, including Germany. The documented development version includes records through 2023. Useful for examining German coalition governments, party systems, cabinet formation, party ideology, and electoral competition during the early 2020s.

returned_title: ParlGov 2024 – Political Parties, Elections, and Cabinets
justification: Documented release of the ParlGov database covering elections and government cabinets through June 2023. Includes structured information on political parties, electoral results, and cabinet membership. Provides comparative context for Germany's 2021 election and subsequent coalition formation. Particularly relevant to research on political institutions, government organization, and parliamentary systems.

returned_title: Manifesto Project Database – Party Policy Preferences, Version 2024a
justification: Comparative dataset containing systematically coded political party election manifestos, including German party programs from the 2020s. Measures party positions on economic policy, welfare, democracy, immigration, environmental protection, foreign policy, and other political issues. Useful for analyzing ideological differences, party competition, electoral platforms, and political polarization in Germany.

returned_title: German Elections Database (GERDA) – German Electoral Results
justification: Research-oriented collection of German election data providing electoral results at multiple geographic levels. Includes datasets for federal elections in 2021 and 2025, including harmonized constituency boundaries for comparison. Especially useful for analyzing regional voting patterns, electoral geography, political polarization, and changes in party support.

returned_title: Konrad Adenauer Foundation – German Election Results and Representative Election Statistics
justification: Collection of election results and representative electoral statistics for Germany, including federal, European Parliament, and state elections conducted during the 2020s. Provides historical comparisons and structured electoral information. Useful for studying party competition, voter turnout, regional political differences, and electoral trends across levels of government.

returned_title: German Agendas Project – Political Agendas and Government Priorities
justification: Academic research data collection examining policy priorities and political agendas in Germany. Includes datasets on governmental and political agendas extending into the early 2020s, with some series covering 2021. Provides information on policy attention, parliamentary activities, government speeches, party positions, and public perceptions of important national problems. Particularly relevant for analyzing political institutions, government responsiveness, and agenda-setting.

returned_title: European Social Survey – Germany, Round 11 (2023–2024)
justification: Major comparative social survey program including Germany in its 2023–2024 survey round. Contains internationally comparable measures of political interest, electoral participation, political trust, satisfaction with democracy, institutional confidence, immigration attitudes, social values, and political orientations. Particularly useful for comparing German political behavior with other European democracies.

returned_title: GESIS – Ongoing Political Attitude Surveys in Germany
justification: GESIS collection covering recurring German political opinion studies, including ARD-DeutschlandTREND, Forsa-Bus, and other surveys concerning political attitudes. Provides a starting point for locating survey datasets from the 2020s on political trust, government approval, party preferences, social concerns, democratic satisfaction, and policy attitudes. Useful for studying political opinion between federal elections.

returned_title: GESIS – Thematic Data Collection on Elections and Political Attitudes
justification: Curated overview of research datasets concerning German elections and political attitudes, including studies associated with the 2025 federal election. Highlights survey resources such as GLES, Politbarometer, DeutschlandTREND, and Forsa-Bus. Useful for identifying relevant individual-level datasets on elections, political participation, public opinion, and government evaluations during the 2020s.

returned_title: German General Social Survey (ALLBUS) 2023
justification: A nationally representative survey conducted in Germany in 2023 by GESIS. Covers social behaviour and attitudes, political attitudes, religion and values, social inequality, lifestyle, personality, employment, and demographic characteristics. Particularly useful for studying relationships between psychological characteristics, social conditions, and political or religious beliefs in Germany during the 2020s.

returned_title: German General Social Survey (ALLBUS) 2021
justification: Provides population survey data collected in Germany in 2021. Relevant to political behaviour and attitudes, social relationships, religion, values, social conditions, and demographic characteristics. Enables investigation of social attitudes and changes in German society during the COVID-19 period.

returned_title: German General Social Survey (ALLBUS) – Cumulation 1980–2023
